name: STiX Apps
subtitle: Hand-picked apps for AltStore PAL and AltStore Classic
description:
Welcome to STiX Apps, a source curated by STiX.

The PAL source lists notarized apps for AltStore PAL (EU, Japan, Brazil). The Classic source lists sideloadable apps for AltStore Classic and SideStore everywhere else.

Everything here is built and validated automatically from https://github.com/STiXzoOR/altsource. Apps are added over time.
